test_title: PYST 21: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 6 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word given in bold in the following sentence.

In his youth Joyonto must have been **startlingly **handsome.
solution:
The solution is **amazingly**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the word given in bold in "In his youth Joyonto must have been **startlingly **handsome." is amazingly.
 
• In his youth Joyonto must have been amazingly handsome.
 
• Therefore **option 4 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Enviously - **Feeling or showing envy.
 
• **Lightly - **Gently, delicately or softly.
 
• **Wrinkly - **Having many lines or folds.
